rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ 'Capacitors store charge.' ✅ They store *energy* in an electric field; the net charge is zero (q on one plate, -q on other).  ·  ❌ 'Capacitance depends on charge and potential.' ✅ It depends only on *physical geometry* (area, distance, dielectric) of the capacitor, not on the charge currently stored.
